items.followUp: What are the two main parts of an email message?

rubric.why: The header is one of the two main parts of a message.
rubric.description: Names the header as a part of the message.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the header.

rubric.why: The body is the part that carries the main message.
rubric.description: Names the body as a part of the message.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the body.

modelAnswer: An electronic message has two main parts: the header and the body.
The header contains details such as the sender, recipient, and subject; the body contains the main message.
